notes.title: My new game - MAZAICA
notes.content:
My new puzzle game - MAZAICA is coming out on 1st September 2024.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964420/MAZAICA/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28984194/4c16061f8dd812c08bfe1369aa364aef41464534.png[/img]

It's very relaxing yet quite challenging. 
Feel free to add it to your wishlist!

Cheers
Mike

notes.title: New game - Scalak - releases on 23 May
notes.content:
Hey guys, Hamster here.

My new puzzle game Scalak is coming out on May 23. 
You can take a look / wishlist it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858760/Scalak/

I hope you'll enjoy it a lot!
Thanks.

notes.title: New game is almost in!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

We've teamed up with Maciej ([b]Hook, Klocki, oO[/b]), and created quite a special puzzle game - PUSH. It will be out in the next month, and honestly - we're super excited to share the results with you.

Have a look, and the game page, feel free to wishlist it:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/676430/PUSH/

Thank you!
Best
Mike
